# cato_users (Data Source)

Retrieves account users.

## Example Usage

```terraform
## Providers ###
provider "cato" {
  baseurl    = "https://api.catonetworks.com/api/v1/graphql2"
  token      = var.cato_token
  account_id = var.account_id
}

### Data Source Usage ###

# Example: Read all users
data "cato_users" "all" {}

# Example: Read users by display name
data "cato_users" "by_name" {
  name_filter = ["Jane Doe", "John Smith"]
}

# Example: Read users by email
data "cato_users" "by_email" {
  email_filter = ["jane.doe@example.com", "john.smith@example.com"]
}

# Example: Read only locally-provisioned (MANUAL) users
# import_type_filter accepts one of: INTEGRATION, LDAP, MANUAL, SCIM
data "cato_users" "manual_only" {
  import_type_filter = "MANUAL"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email_filter` (List of String) List of user emails to filter
- `import_type_filter` (String) Filter by user import type (INTEGRATION, LDAP, MANUAL, SCIM)
- `name_filter` (List of String) List of user display names to filter

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) List of users (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) Email
- `first_name` (String) First name
- `id` (String) ID
- `last_name` (String) Last name
- `user_import_type` (String) User import type
- `user_status` (String) User status
